rounds.notes: You mostly want to play it safe, your bubble is still a baby and won't do much unless anyone caught inside decide to never leave because they never see any competent Winston player run [Tesla Field](item_68f73d99-6d07-40f5-ad28-0c69f45487c7) on the first round.

round_upgrades.notes:
This playstyle is better suited for jumping over your enemies and plopping a gift over their heads, while you can do your melee + land combo, you mostly just want to tickle them as much as you can.

There's also a psychological aspect, anyone seeing you run this will proabbly see you as easy pickings.

rounds.notes: Now you try to build somewhere around a 2:1 ratio of ability to weapon power, you mostly want to be on harassment and cleanup duty, always place your barriers where you plan to fight, in between their front line and backline yielded the best results for me.

rounds.notes:
I do NOT recommend getting [Unstable Prototype](item_3c4fac62-90b1-49f8-8602-ba89abcbf437) under any circumstances. It is way too expensive for too little benefit.

[Simian Supplements](item_7e9a42b8-2aed-4932-bba4-8ac0925ae355) is a non-negotiable. More barrier uptime means more damage and woe to any enemy Ana players.
